title: jmap-vtc-livekit: LiveKit SFU + Egress media backend adapter
description: Second backend kind (SFU + egress) so the VtcBackend media hooks stay vendor-neutral (docs/design/vtc-broadcast-research.md §po6q.5a). LiveKit Egress for VTCRecording (room composite/track to MP4/HLS, S3 upload), push livestreams to RTMP/SRT, room composite layouts; hosted-mode sub-second playback via MediaMTX WHEP with per-viewer JWT minted in playback_endpoints_for. Implements the post-write media hooks and reports state with the media_report helpers from po6q.2. Tests against wiremock (LiveKit Twirp API). Open question for Mark (research note): is LiveKit the reference SFU? If yes this becomes the default adapter.
